component.name: Input
component.description: Text input component with leading/trailing icon slots, loading state, and form field integration.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Input wrapper that positions icons, loading state, and the native input.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Icon or loading indicator rendered before the input value.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Icon or loading indicator rendered after the input value.

own.name: autocomplete
own.description: The autocomplete attribute for the input.

own.name: autofocus
own.description: Whether the input should automatically receive focus on mount.

own.name: autofocusDelay
own.description: The delay in milliseconds before automatically focusing the input.

own.name: children
own.description: Additional content to render inside the input container.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the input is disabled.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: leading
own.description: Leading icon name.

own.name: loading
own.description: Whether the input is in a loading state.

own.name: loadingIcon
own.description: The icon to show when the input is in a loading state.

own.name: maxLength
own.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the input.

own.name: modelModifiers
own.description: Modifiers for the input value (e.g., trim, lazy, number).

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onBlur
own.description: Event handler for the blur event.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the input value change is committed.

own.name: onFocus
own.description: Event handler for the focus event.

own.name: onInput
own.description: Event handler for the input event.

own.name: onValueChange
own.description: Callback when the input value changes during input.

own.name: placeholder
own.description: The placeholder text for the input.

own.name: readOnly
own.description: Whether the input is read-only.

own.name: required
own.description: Whether the input is required.

own.name: trailing
own.description: Trailing icon name.

own.name: type
own.description: The type of the input element.

own.name: value
own.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

aria.name: aria-busy
aria.description: Accessibility attribute forwarded by the rendered component.

aria.name: aria-disabled
aria.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

aria.name: aria-readonly
aria.description: Indicates that the control value cannot be changed by the user.

aria.name: aria-required
aria.description: Indicates that user input is required.

data.name: data-loading
data.description: Present when the component is loading.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-disabled
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-readonly
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that the control value cannot be changed by the user.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-required
ariaAttributes.description: Indicates that user input is required.
